task.title: Serve Trade Journey and loop-run reads from Postgres
task.head_sha_note: This manifest is committed after the checksummed code head and intentionally does not self-reference.

not_changing: reader cutover or target-dev flag activation

reader_contract.scope: tenant_id and environment are mandatory for every relational read
reader_contract.pagination: HMAC integrity-protected keyset cursor bound to scope, filters (including explicit false and loop status), sort, and cursor kind; default 50, maximum 200, query limit page_size + 1
reader_contract.fallback: A selected but unavailable/misconfigured Postgres reader returns unavailable; JSON is not represented as current Postgres truth.
reader_contract.freshness: Controller state is read from the scoped controller row and formal truth requires accepted_live=true, status=ready, and mode=live.
